title: Meta Instagram App ID and App Secret: public status and relation to the Meta app secret
summary: The Instagram App ID shown beside the Instagram App Secret in the Instagram business login settings, and the Meta app ID and app secret shown elsewhere in the App Dashboard.
rationale: Claims instagram-app-secret-shown-with-instagram-app-id and instagram-app-id-differs-by-login-type record that the two are shown together, and that the Instagram App ID and the Meta app ID are different identifiers by login type. The Instagram App ID is a required request parameter and no page calls it non-secret (open question instagram-app-id-public-status; benign sibling instagram-app-id, class unresolved). Whether the Instagram App Secret is a different value from the Meta app secret is not stated (instagram-secret-same-value-as-meta-app-secret), and whether an appsecret_proof-style derived output applies to Instagram Login calls is not stated (instagram-secret-derived-outputs-unstated). A public-identifier control for the App ID would assert what the pages do not. Contract claims cited: instagram-app-secret/instagram-app-secret-shown-with-instagram-app-id, instagram-app-secret/instagram-app-id-differs-by-login-type.

expectation.rationale: No outcome is asserted. Settled by: a Meta statement of whether the Instagram App ID is public and whether the Instagram App Secret is the Meta app secret.

sources.supports: In the App Dashboard > Instagram > API setup with Instagram login > 3. Set up Instagram business login > Business login settings, you will need: Your app's Instagram App ID; Your app's Instagram App Secret
sources.locator: IDs from the Meta App Dashboard

sources.supports: Apps that use Facebook Login for Business will use the Meta app ID displayed at the top of the Meta App Dashboard for your app. Apps that use Business Login for Instagram will use the Instagram app ID displayed on the Instagram > API setup with Instagram login section of the dashboard.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
